1. How to Find & Copy Bilibili Video URLs on Desktop (PC & Mac)

Locating video links on a desktop browser (such as Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, or Apple Safari) is the quickest way to queue downloads in high quality.

Method A: The Browser Address Bar (Recommended)

When watching any video on bilibili.com, simply click on the address bar at the top of your web browser.

Standard Desktop Video URL Format: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xx411c7mD/
  • Highlight the entire URL with Ctrl + A (Windows) or Cmd + A (Mac).
  • Copy it to your clipboard with Ctrl + C or Cmd + C.

Method B: Using the On-Player Share Menu

If you are viewing the video in mini-player mode or inside an embedded frame:

  1. Hover over the video player or scroll just below the playback window.
  2. Click on the Share icon (an arrow or forwarding icon near the Like and Coin buttons).
  3. Click Copy Link (复制链接). The exact canonical URL will be saved to your clipboard.

2. How to Find & Copy Bilibili URLs on Mobile App (iPhone, iPad & Android)

The official Bilibili mobile app for iOS and Android handles links differently by generating shortened tracking links (beginning with b23.tv). Here is how to extract them effortlessly:

Step-by-Step Mobile Extraction:

  1. Open the Bilibili App: Navigate to the video you wish to save.
  2. Tap the Share Button: Look at the top right of the active video player or beneath the video title for the Share icon (represented by an arrow pointing upwards or to the right).
  3. Tap "Copy Link" (复制链接): A bottom drawer will slide up displaying various sharing channels (WeChat, Weibo, QQ, etc.). Swipe until you see the link icon labeled Copy Link and tap it.
  4. Handling the Copied Message: The Bilibili app frequently copies a snippet of promotional Chinese text along with the link, for example:
    Raw Copied App Text Example: 【【4KHDR】ULTRA HD 60帧 测试片源】 https://b23.tv/aBcDeFg 复制链接打开哔哩哔哩
    Good News: You do not need to manually delete the Chinese text. BiliExtract's smart parser automatically scans your input, isolates the b23.tv/... link, unrolls the redirect, and resolves the clean video stream!

3. Understanding Bilibili URL Formats (BV ID, AV ID & Shortlinks)

Over the years, Bilibili has utilized multiple URL schemes. BiliExtract is engineered to accept and parse every valid Bilibili video format seamlessly:

Format Type Structure Example Description
BV Identifier (Modern) bilibili.com/video/BV1R1e4zKEh1 Standard Base58-encoded ID used since 2020. Recommended format.
b23.tv Shortlink (Mobile) https://b23.tv/XYZ123 Generated by the iOS and Android apps when sharing.
AV Number (Legacy) bilibili.com/video/av170001 Original numeric identifier system. Fully supported.
Raw BV / AV Code BV1R1e4zKEh1 or av115071804 You can paste just the code itself without any prefix or protocol!

5. Bilibili Quality Breakdown: Why Are Some 1080p Videos Silent?

A common point of confusion among new Bilibili users is how high-resolution video is delivered:

💡 Why Bilibili Uses DASH Streaming:

For any resolution at or above 1080P, Bilibili utilizes DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP). Under DASH, the video stream and the audio track are stored as two separate data streams on Bilibili's CDN.

If you download a 1080P video under the Video Only (DASH) tab, it will not have an embedded audio track. To enjoy high-definition video with crystal-clear audio:

  1. Download the 1080P MP4 from the Video Only (DASH) tab.
  2. Download the MP3 / M4A audio file from the Audio tab.
  3. Combine them in seconds using free tools like FFmpeg, VLC Media Player, or online video joiners.

If you prefer instant 1-click playback without combining files, simply download from the Video + Audio tab (which offers 720P HD with sound already built-in).

6. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Do I need to create a Bilibili account or sign in to download? ▼
No. BiliExtract extracts publicly available streams directly from Bilibili's CDN infrastructure without requiring your personal account credentials, passwords, or browser cookies.
Can I download Bilibili videos on iPhone and iPad Camera Roll? ▼
Yes! Simply copy the b23.tv link from the Bilibili app, open Safari, paste it into BiliExtract, tap Download MP4, and select 'Save Video' in Safari's download manager to store it directly in your iOS Photos app.
Why did my download link return a 403 Forbidden or 412 error on other websites? ▼
Bilibili's media servers inspect HTTP Referer and User-Agent headers to prevent third-party hotlinking. BiliExtract operates an intelligent edge proxy that injects the required headers, ensuring your downloads start smoothly without 403 or 412 blocks.
How fast is the downloading process? ▼
Because BiliExtract streams data directly through high-bandwidth reverse proxies without caching heavy video files to server disk, downloads occur at the maximum speed supported by your internet connection.
